cross_model_claim: Both models support targeted retrieval followed by a distributed trace-state pathway to count readout, but only Gemma satisfies the complete preregistered generated-suffix serial bridge. Qwen supports a weaker count-dependent margin pathway.

gemma.allowed_claim: Gemma Top-6 retrieval heads causally affect the generated terminal item, whose L16:41 full-span state mediates the answer-count effect.

qwen.allowed_claim: Qwen Top-128 targeted retrieval changes the generated terminal suffix; restoring the multi-token post-query suffix state produces a moderate, matched-control-adjusted repair of count margin. The registered probability-utility serial-chain gate did not pass, so this is a partial distributed-state pathway, not a complete or exclusive terminal-counter claim.

clean_state_restoration_margin.rule: selected clean-restore minus self-state margin CI low > 0

restoration_specificity_margin.rule: selected minus mean-random restoration CI low > 0

targeted_receiver_damage_margin.rule: mean-random minus selected self-state margin CI low > 0
